PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

PC-452-17; Application to Remove or Lower 3 trees Located in the Parkways Adjacent to 2216, 2217 and 2209 Via Acalones and 3 Trees Located in the Parkway Adjacent to 2217 Via Guadalana
Applicant: Tom Bechler
2229 Via La Brea
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended approval to lower the Carob trees adjacent to 2216 and 2217 Via Acalones and the Liquidamber tree located adjacent to 2209 Via Acalones to approximately 20 feet in height at the Urban Foresterâ€™s direction and maintain the trees with an annual no-fee permit. Recommend approval to remove 3 Eucalyptus trees located adjacent to 2217 Via Guadalana according to the â€˜Standard Conditions For Tree Removal Approvalsâ€™ and that a future application for the remaining Carob tree be prioritized to expedite consideration by the Parklands Committee. Committee member Rubincam modified the motion accepted by Committee member Kaviani to change the trimming of the Liquidamber to trim this tree to a lesser amount at the Urban Foresterâ€™s direction. (5-0 in favor)
b.
PC-453-17; Application to Retain Non-Native Plantings Located Adjacent to 913 Via Del Monte on the Guadalana Path
Action: Recommended approval to maintain a portion of the plantings adjacent to 913 Via Del Monte on the Guadalana Path with an agreement requiring regular maintenance to keep the path, accessible and safe with a walkable path free of obstructions and trip items of approximately 10 feet (reduced width of 5 feet at Via Del Monte and widening to 10 feet).
(5-0 in favor)

Action: Approved the applications with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The proposed driveway top of â€œxâ€ extends to the prolongation of the property line into the right-of-way in the frontage of the adjacent property. The driveway top of â€œxâ€ shall be a minimum of 1 foot from the prolongation of the property line; 2) The project creates, adds or replaces more than 10,000 square feet of impervious surface and portions of the lot being graded/excavated exceed 25% grade; thus, the project shall comply with the Cityâ€™s municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C; 3) Los Angeles County Sewer Maintenance District information indicates that a sewer line and manhole lie within the subject property. The developer shall determine the actual location of the sewer infrastructure and easements and show on the plans. No object, whether a permanent structure, or a temporary structure, or any object which is difficult to remove are allowed within sewer easements and any grading within the sewer easement shall be approved prior to issuance of any building permits; 4) Concentrated storm water discharge onto unimproved slopes is not allowed. Developer shall obtain drainage release letters from adjacent property owners allowing discharge onto their property or storm water shall be pumped to Via Barcelona; 5) If an electronic transformer is necessary for the project, the placement of the transformer shall be on private property. Prior to the installation of the transformer, approval by the Cityâ€™s Planning and Engineering Departments must be obtained. In the event the transformer cannot be placed on private property and must be located within the City right-of-way, a Miscellaneous application for the non-standard encroachment must be submitted and approved by the Planning Commission; and 6) The second floor chimney shall be removed. (4-0 in favor, Evans absent)
